name: bufi/skills
abstract: Multi-collection agent skills catalog and thin TypeScript CLI for BUFI Desk across Personal scope, Team Treasury scope, Personal-to-Team AI collaboration, and Agent Commerce (x402 / Marketplace / ERC-8183). Teaches agents when to use the Team LiveKit room, W2W Walkie-Talkie channel, Official MCP, In-Page WebMCP, or the Thin TypeScript CLI, while guaranteeing money always lands in the BuIsland miniplayer and Pending Decisions Inbox.

agentic_collaboration.description: Routing, signed-in Desk context, in-workspace Team LiveKit room, cross-workspace W2W Walkie-Talkie, A2A handoff, and WebMCP realtime cursors.

personal_finance.description: Personal wallet transfers & swaps, personal documents & inbox, ARCA tax connection, and the Personal-to-Team AI collaboration bridge.

team_treasury.description: Team treasury proposals (Safe / Squads / single-sig), Li.Fi swaps & Morpho/Aave allocations, reimbursements & bills, invoices & receivables, and payroll & runway.

agent_commerce_x402.description: Agent wallet transfers & HTTP 402 x402 payments, BUFI Marketplace quotes & deals, W2W ERC-8183 escrow jobs, and Yellow Network Nitrolite settlement channels.
